entities.name: 智能体 (agent)

evidence.quote: And so you can, I guess the use case is like pretty easy to wrap your head around, which is, you know, next time let's say your flight gets delayed and you need to call in and you want to change your seat or change your booking, AI agent can handle it for you.

evidence.quote: And that's where the agent comes together.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_04

evidence.quote: Our agent has to essentially follow a multi-step open-ended investigation flow.

evidence.quote: I think for us, it really is the more interesting way to look at it is that everyone's agent is actually quite different.

entities.name: copilot
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:企业中最普及的生成式 AI 用例,但只能辅助个人、不会替你值班守寻呼,加速有限且人始终必须参与。

evidence.quote: You need agents because a copilot is not going to hold your pager.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: Or a human maybe can be assisted by a copilot, but then, you know, the acceleration you have is limited.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: But our view is that agents obviously are a lot more powerful and they create much more acceleration than what maybe a human-driven flow via Copilot can do.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: I think it was very much a head-to-head competitor with GitHub Copilot.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_05

evidence.quote: If you were to think about in the past, Copilot and these kinds of tools would help you in very quickly writing boilerplate code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_05

evidence.quote: And obviously, a topic a lot of people bring up is agent-to-agent collaboration.

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:智能体安全的核心话题,每个客户签约前都要谈;配套红队测试、客户自建单元测试的测试平台,责任上与普通 SaaS 一样设赔付上限。

evidence.quote: Can you talk a little bit about what does that shared responsibility model look like when it comes to guardrails?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Guardrails are really important.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_04

entities.name: 红队测试 (red team)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:大客户的验证手段——雇安全公司或由安全团队千方百计让智能体出错,Decagon 一直经受住了这些考验。

evidence.quote: We've even had customers that they will red team us themselves, where they either hire a firm or their security team goes in and tries to get it to mess up in a thousand different ways.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_04

entities.name: MCP
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:让模型连接企业内部数据系统的协议,很多公司在谈论、是定制化方向,但安全是大漏洞(不能让随便一个开发者访问最关键数据库),还达不到跨智能体协作所需的工具水平。

evidence.quote: Obviously, we don't even know if this is the future protocol, but MCP is something that a lot of companies talk about.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_05

evidence.quote: I think tools like MCP are really, really interesting.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_05

evidence.quote: I think MCP is not there.

entities.name: 自建还是购买 (build versus buy)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:取决于是不是业务核心——非核心能力自建要补告警、监控、护栏,成本远超想象;demo 一天能搭出来,生产级应用可能是最难的事;但贴合业务的浅层小工具领域专家已能自己造。

evidence.quote: So I think that the build versus buy thing ends up not being that big of a, I think, talking point in our space.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_04

entities.name: 人在回路 (human in the loop)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:按可逆性分级——可逆操作智能体做、完全不可逆的必须人批准,今天生产环境的智能体更像自动驾驶汽车,按复杂度、敏感度和监管分级决定人何时介入。

evidence.quote: And so actually maybe starting with Jesse and then Spiros, you know, do you have a framework of thinking about what are the types of tasks that should be done by end-to-end by an agent versus when it makes sense to have a human in the loop?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 接受率 (acceptance rate)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:Windsurf 很快砍掉的指标,因为太容易被操纵——只显示行末花括号接受率就是 100% 但价值为零。

evidence.quote: There are some metrics we killed very quickly, like acceptance rate.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_05

evidence.quote: You could imagine if a product just shows no suggestions but an end of line curly brace, that would be 100% acceptance rate.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_05

entities.name: 沙箱 (sandbox)
entities.how_described: 本集提到:Decagon 为大客户跑一个 sandbox 让他们先测试智能体、建立信心。

evidence.quote: For larger engagements, there is some sort of proving process, and so we will run a sandbox for them, and they'll be able to test it out and so on, and that helps with a lot of buy-in.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_04
